evidence_response: The frozen primary-source audit separates target; unit; access; training role; data; and blind protocol from AgentRewardBench and WebGraphEval.
remaining_vulnerability: Differentiation is narrow and cannot rely on firstness; method novelty; or a cross-paper performance advantage.
publication_impact: A reviewer may judge the package as careful validation rather than a sufficiently new contribution.

evidence_response: Simplicity is the studied object and is backed by held-out signal; efficiency; and diagnostic evidence.
remaining_vulnerability: The classifier and features remain technically modest and do not constitute algorithmic novelty.
publication_impact: Requires strong empirical and evaluation framing.

evidence_response: Identity fields are excluded; feature-group removals and metadata diagnostics expose rather than hide shortcut risks.
remaining_vulnerability: Task difficulty and semantic shortcuts are not independently controlled; metadata retains signal.
publication_impact: Can weaken the interpretation from quality evaluation to morphology correlation.

evidence_response: Official labels; disagreement exclusions; non-causal wording; and morphology-semantic error cases are explicit.
remaining_vulnerability: Outcome; process; morphology; and expert-label constructs are not independently validated.
publication_impact: Limits claims about understanding or mechanism.

evidence_response: Benchmark/model identifiers are excluded from B2 and a post-freeze grouped metadata-only diagnostic is reported.
remaining_vulnerability: Metadata predicts both targets on dev and B2 is only descriptively higher; confounding is not eliminated.
publication_impact: Requires prominent limitation and restrained interpretation.

evidence_response: Frozen ablations show repetition-group dependence and the paper limits this to predictive association.
remaining_vulnerability: Repetition features directly mirror the Looping construct; the strong result may appear tautological rather than a novel evaluator insight.
publication_impact: Threatens the novelty of one of two confirmatory targets.

evidence_response: Side Effect is preregistered and retained as exploratory only with exact dev/test support and no confirmatory upgrade.
remaining_vulnerability: Only 12 dev positives supported model freezing and thresholded test F1 is weak.
publication_impact: Cannot support a three-dimension confirmatory story.

evidence_response: Dev LOBO and blind held-out evidence are reported with an explicit within-family scope boundary.
remaining_vulnerability: No independent dataset or unseen benchmark family is evaluated; the original benchmark-shift framing is therefore only partially realized.
publication_impact: Strong publication bottleneck and likely request for new experiments.

evidence_response: Per-family metrics and macro summaries retain all four domains and label heterogeneity as descriptive.
remaining_vulnerability: AssistantBench is substantially weaker and no pairwise inferential tests are preregistered.

evidence_response: The frozen B4 comparator uses the same grouped protocol and preserves uncertain AP gains plus a stable Success F1 drop.
remaining_vulnerability: Only one encoder; one pooling design; and one downstream classifier are covered.
publication_impact: Cannot establish a general structure-versus-semantics hierarchy.

evidence_response: Local tiers include prevalence; structural; TF-IDF; ablations; and a dense semantic control.
remaining_vulnerability: No protocol-equivalent LLM judge; graph evaluator; or directly comparable published numerical baseline is available.
publication_impact: Reviewer may request stronger contemporary comparators.

evidence_response: Task-group cluster intervals; invalid-draw accounting; exact verification; and conservative claim grades support the two confirmatory signals.
remaining_vulnerability: Relative method and benchmark comparisons remain uncertain or descriptive by design.
publication_impact: Core signal claims are statistically defensible if relative claims stay bounded.

evidence_response: Predictions were frozen before labels and confirmatory claims explicitly say official held-out tasks within evaluated families.
remaining_vulnerability: Blind held-out does not equal unseen-benchmark or independent external validation.
publication_impact: Must be stated prominently in title; abstract; and discussion.

evidence_response: Primary-source audits classify work by properties and prohibit invalid numeric rankings.
remaining_vulnerability: DIRECTLY_COMPARABLE is zero; therefore the paper cannot demonstrate a cross-paper performance advantage.
publication_impact: Weakens competitive positioning but protects validity.

evidence_response: Environment-qualified cost and failure diagnostics show practical resource and error implications.
remaining_vulnerability: No calibration; selective prediction; online deployment; intervention; or user-impact evaluation exists.
publication_impact: Practical claims must remain diagnostic rather than deployment-ready.
